views: Sectional elevation at X-X (longitudinal section along barrel)
summary: Longitudinal sectional elevation showing the proposed extension of an existing single-cell RCC box culvert under quadrupled railway tracks. The existing barrel on the left (length 9376 mm, clear height 900 mm) is extended on the right by a proposed RCC box barrel (length 11073 mm, clear height 1200 mm) across a 464 mm sheet pile shoring gap. The proposed barrel features 350 mm thick top and bottom slabs on 300 mm sand fill and 300 mm compacted GSB layers, terminating in a 3516 mm downstream flooring apron and a 700 mm thick drop wall. Four tracks cross overhead: Existing Main Line, Proposed Overshoot Line, Proposed Main Line, and Proposed Overshoot Line.
